verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MU biro-eby'ennaku
Yesu-onnyambenga
Nneme-okugwa wansi,
Nga nkwerabidde.
Bwe mba mbuusabuusa,
Ontunuulire,
Ompanirirenga
Olw'amaanyi go.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Enkwe za Ssetaani
Ze zinnumba-ennyo,
Obugagga-obw'ensi
Businza-omwoyo
Ka njijukireggwe
Eyafiirira:
Ggwe-oli kigo kyange
Mwe neekweka nze.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu bw'onoobanga
Onkangavvula,
Byonna-ebijja ku nze
Ka mbikkirize;
Neewaayo nze gy'oli
Ndi wuwo wekka,
-Ontukuze,ombeere,
Ennaku zonna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mu ntalo-ez'entiisa
Nkwesiga wekka
Bwe ndinafuwala,
Ojjanga gye ndi;
Omubiri gwange
Ne bwe gulifa,
-Onzuukize mu bafu
Nze-akweyabiza.
